name: Defensive
description: Survives through Guard, damage reduction, barriers, and protection effects.

focuses.name: Unbreakable Aegis
focuses.description: Aegis Barrier +20%. While Aegis is active, damage taken -10%. Aegis prevents one interrupt, stun, silence, knockback, or displacement effect.

focuses.name: Second Wind
focuses.description: If you would take lethal damage while at 75+ Guard, consume 75 Guard, prevent death, set Health to 1, immediately activate Aegis at 75 Guard strength, and heal for 6% Max Health over 4 seconds. 120 second cooldown.

focuses.name: Counterpoise
focuses.description: When Aegis breaks or expires, your next Essence ability within 8 seconds gains up to +12% Effect Potency based on damage absorbed by Aegis. Bonus = absorbed damage / 20% Max Health, capped at 12%. Also refunds 15% resource cost and refunds 10% cooldown if it defeats an enemy or successfully applies a debuff/control effect.

coreMechanic: Gain Guard from incoming pressure: being attacked, taking damage, blocking, dodging, absorbing hits, and using Essence abilities while injured. Defensive also grants Aegis, which spends Guard to create Barrier, reduce crowd-control duration, and reduce interruption pressure.

skillTreeNodes.name: Iron Frame
skillTreeNodes.description: Max Health +8%. While below 35% Health, direct damage taken -10%. Aegis Barrier +10% when cast below 50% Health.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Deflection Habit
skillTreeNodes.description: Dodging, blocking, parrying, or fully absorbing an attack grants the same Guard as taking Health damage. First direct hit taken every 8 seconds deals 8% less damage. Enemy misses still grant +2 Guard.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.

skillTreeNodes.description: Using any Essence ability below 75% Health grants +3 additional Guard. Using any Essence ability below 50% Health grants 5% damage reduction for 3 seconds. 6 second internal cooldown.

skillTreeNodes.name: Protected Execution
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DefensiveConversion. After Aegis activates, your next Essence ability within 8 seconds becomes Protected. Protected abilities cannot be interrupted. Damage, healing, barrier, resource, and utility effects gain +8% Effect Potency. Debuff and control effects gain +10% application chance. Summon and persistent effects gain +10% duration.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching DefensiveConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Sheltered Momentum
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DefensiveTempo. While Aegis is active, eligible Essence abilities recover cooldown faster and cost less resource. If Aegis survives its full duration, regain a portion of the Guard spent.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching DefensiveTempo.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a small potency safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.

skillTreeNodes.name: Ward the Many
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: SupportConversion. When you create a Barrier with an Essence ability, 20% of the Barrier value is also applied to your lowest-Health controlled ally. If no controlled ally exists, 15% of excess Barrier applied to you becomes Guard. While Aegis is active, this shared Barrier value is increased by 50%.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching SupportConversion.
